import sys

tabs = [str(path) for path in sorted(pathlib.Path('.').glob('*.py')) if '\t' in path.read_text()]
for path in tabs:
    print(f'{path}: indent with spaces, not tabs')
sys.exit(1 if tabs else 0)

import pathlib
import re
import subprocess

root = subprocess.run(['git', 'rev-list', '--max-parents=0', 'HEAD'], capture_output=True, text=True,
                      check=True).stdout.split()[0]
before = subprocess.run(['git', 'show', f'{root}:AGENTS.md'], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
after = pathlib.Path('AGENTS.md').read_text()
block = re.compile(r'(?ms)^<!-- INTELLIGENCE:BEGIN.*?^<!-- INTELLIGENCE:END -->')
assert block.search(before) and block.search(after), 'the managed block is gone'
assert block.search(before).group(0) == block.search(after).group(0), 'the managed block changed'
outside = block.sub('', after)
assert len(outside.splitlines()) <= 60, f'{len(outside.splitlines())} lines outside the block, more than a page'
